title: Universality of two-dimensional Markovian holonomy fields
summary: We prove a universality theorem for a broad class of two-dimensional gauge theories on compact surfaces. Each admissible conjugation-invariant Lévy process on a compact connected Lie group determines a universality class of lattice gauge theories whose continuum limit is the associated Markovian holonomy process. Our result can be seen as a gauge-theoretic analogue of invariance principles for random walks and Lévy processes. This framework includes the Yang--Mills holonomy process and the standard heat-kernel (Villain), Wilson, and Manton lattice actions. The proof uses state-sum formulas…
